verdict.rationale: Datadog provides an API Reference and OpenTelemetry/tracing docs (APM) that imply official client libraries/SDKs for instrumenting code, plus a public API reference for programmatic access, which an AI-native developer could build against. However, the evidence pack never explicitly lists or documents dedicated SDK pages (e.g., per-language client libraries) or shows AI-specific SDK usage guidance. Missing for 10: explicit official SDK/client-library documentation pages, examples of AI-native or agentic usage of the SDKs, and independent corroboration of developers building against them.
